items.title: Greek Key Picket Fence Circular Maze DXF Panel
items.description: Bold Greek key borders top and bottom frame dense vertical picket-style stripes, broken in the middle by a circular labyrinth medallion with a small flower at its core. The strong vertical rhythm of the pickets makes this panel read almost like a traditional fence design elevated with a decorative centerpiece.
